name: JL Solar
old_description: Welcome to JL Solar, your reliable partner in electrical services, solar installations, and EV charger installations. We are committed to providing high-quality solutions that harness the power of renewable energy, ensuring a sustainable future for our customers and the environment. With a team of experienced professionals, we specialize in designing and implementing tailored solar systems and electric vehicle charging infrastructure. At JL Solar, we prioritize innovation, efficiency, and customer satisfaction as we work to meet your energy needs.
about:
JL Solar is a family-owned electrical company based in Odessa, Missouri. The business is led by CEO Shawna Lockwood, Chief Brand Strategist Kiera Meloy, and Director of Operations James Lockwood, a master electrician with over 25 years of experience. The company began as a family-run operation dedicated to providing electrical services to the Midwest community.

The company specializes in designing and installing solar energy systems, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and backup power solutions for residential and commercial clients. Its solar services span commercial, utility-scale, battery storage, residential, non-profit, carport, and off-grid installations. Electrical capabilities include residential and commercial wiring, underground wiring, electrical excavation, and diagnostic services. The team handles projects from consultation through post-installation support.

JL Solar serves homeowners, businesses, non-profits, and utility-scale projects across the Midwest. Customers include residential property owners seeking rooftop solar, commercial facilities requiring three-phase electrical work, and organizations pursuing off-grid or battery storage solutions. The company also installs EV chargers for both residential and commercial properties.

The firm emphasizes family values, personalized service, and a commitment to safety, integrity, and professionalism. Leadership highlights the master electrician’s decades of experience as a foundation for quality workmanship, and the company aims to build lasting client relationships through tailored energy solutions.
